test_group_norm_simple: test the GroupNorm layer with 5 groups on a 4D input tensor without scale or offset
test_group_norm_with_scale_offset: test the GroupNorm layer with custom scale and offset initializers on a 4D input tensor
test_group_norm_nchw_format: test the GroupNorm layer with NCHW data format and custom scale and offset initializers
test_group_norm_data_format_agnostic: test that GroupNorm produces identical outputs for channels last and channels first data formats
test_group_norm_external_tensors: test the GroupNorm layer by passing external scale and offset tensors at call time
